checklist.action: Open the packaged manuscript/main.pdf from the final JSS submission archive, not a stale working-tree copy.
checklist.record: viewer, archive filename, and archive timestamp

checklist.action: Confirm that the viewer reports 54 pages and that the count matches pdf_render_audit and jss_full_audit.

Before accepting the visual review, confirm that the PDF was opened from `Paper-JSS/manuscript/main.pdf` after extracting `build/statspai-jss-submission.zip`, then compare the archive size and file count with `build/statspai-jss-submission-manifest.md` or the final verifier output.
checklist.record: archive size, file count, PDF member path, and manifest/verifier source

checklist.action: Use the generated page inventory below to jump to front matter, section starts, tables, figures, references, and boundary-text pages before the full page-by-page scan.
checklist.record: pages checked from inventory plus any mismatch

checklist.action: Inspect pages 1 through 54 for blank pages, missing content, or unexpected dark/empty pages.
Check title, authors, affiliations, abstract, keywords, date, JSS class styling, and page headers.
Scan every page for clipped text, overlapping lines, broken equations, unreadable code font, or orphaned headings.
checklist.record: page and object for each issue

checklist.action: Check that all tables, figures, captions, and legends are readable and not split or clipped in a way that blocks review.
checklist.record: table or figure label for each issue

checklist.action: Spot-check references, citations, URLs, and internal links for visible rendering and unresolved-marker drift.
checklist.record: marker, citation, or URL issue if any

checklist.action: Confirm that validation-tier, source-snapshot, data-provenance, agent-claim, and final manual PDF visual-check boundary wording is visible.
Compare the first, second, middle, and last pages against the Poppler sample pages named in pdf_render_audit.

After all checks pass, record reviewer name, date, viewer, archive name, and any accepted residual visual issue in the upload worklog. Do not change this generated protocol to claim acceptance unless the human review is actually done.
